title: City Lights
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Under city lights we walk
We're talking endlessly, but you don't know my thoughts (You don't know my thoughts)
And there's this tension between us
And I just wanna cut it off

[Chorus]
We're in the city of dreams tonight
Where the stars and skyline meet
Our hearts will collide
Echoing through the city's heartbeat
City of dreams tonight
Where the stars and skyline meet
Our hearts will collide
Echoing through the city's heartbeat

[Instrumental Break]

[Verse 2]
Walking side-by-side so close (Walking side-by-side so close)
We're talking freely, but it seems like your heart's closed
In this city's glow, we wander
I'm hoping your door won't close, but do you? (You, you-you-you)

[Chorus]
We're in the city of dreams tonight
Where the stars and skyline meet
Our hearts will collide
Echoing through the city's heartbeat (Echoing through the city)
City of dreams tonight (City of dreams tonight)
Where the stars and skyline meet (Where the stars and skyline meet)
Our hearts will collide (Our hearts will collide)
Echoing through the city's heartbeat
